t: This is the Korean War Memorial in Victoria Embankment Gardens, between the Thames and the Ministry of Defence headquarters. A bronze statue of a British soldier stands beside a Portland stone obelisk on a Welsh slate base. It was a gift from the Government of South Korea, unveiled on the third of December 2014 in a ceremony led by Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester. The statue is by the sculptor Philip Jackson, who has been Royal Sculptor to Queen Elizabeth the Second.
